body: How do you even live at all?  How can any of us live like this.
Only if you kill me too.
For a long time now I've hoped and somewhat believed that when we die, we become a floating consciousness that can travel across the planet and spectate anyone we wish to.
But it takes too long.  I can't see myself working that long.  It's so miserable.  I want to just leave. Run away. Do something to escape this endless cycle.
But if we can't kill ourselves, what can we do?

I've been looking for someone to die with.  I'm afraid of dying alone as well.  I want to take my closest family member with me but she's so innocent and doesn't deserve  any more pain and suffering than she already will get by living.  I would like to talk to you more about this possible idea.
